thread:
jess: Morning — quick async sales standup (pipeline + security asks)
jess: What I did yesterday: demo with MacroHealth execs, shared pricing deck, collected SOC2 checklist items.
jess: Blockers: MacroHealth legal wants SAML SSO + IP allowlist for our demo env; also need log export for their audit team. Can engineering help with a short-lived demo VPC?

omar: Congrats on the demo! MacroHealth is promising. For IP allowlists we usually provide a CIDR range for our dedicated demo host.
omar: Also FYI, procurement asked for proof of data residency for EU customers — do we have an FAQ link? :thinking:

leah: @jess, I can prep the legal artifact bundle (SLA, DPA) but I need a contact at eng for the technical bits (SSO config + logs).

jess: Thanks @leah — contact is @sam-eng. Sam, can you advise on estimated time to stand up a demo VPC with SAML SP and IP allowlist? Need it within 48-72h if possible.

sam-eng: Heads-up — we can provision a short-lived demo VPC, but need the following: tenant id, desired CIDR for allowlist, and which auth provider (Okta/Azure).
sam-eng: Rough ETA: 1 day to create infra + 1 day to configure SAML and log forwarding if no unexpected blockers.

omar: For MacroHealth they use Okta. I'll DM the SAML metadata to @sam-eng.

jess: MacroHealth also asked about audit logs — can we provide continuous export to their S3 or do we give them a signed snapshot? Security asked about PII redaction.

sam-eng: We can stream audit logs to a customer S3 with short-lived credentials. For PII redaction, the platform supports token-level redaction rules but needs a policy config from security.

sec-bot: Security checklist link: https://intranet.redwood/sec-requests (contains SOC2 artifacts, audit log export procedures) :lock:

leah: Noted. I'll pull the SOC2 excerpt and the required policy language and attach to MacroHealth legal.

jess: Other pipeline notes: Taylor — quick update on NovaGrid?

taylor: NovaGrid in contract review; pricing negotiation continues but OK to push to next week. No technical blockers.

jess: FYI, flagged one enterprise deal (Orion) that needs a Dedicated capacity quote and a security call. Omar, can you own scheduling with solution engineering?
omar: I can take Orion. I'll coordinate with @sam-eng for a technical deep-dive.

jess: Quick asks:
- @sam-eng: please ack when you get MacroHealth SAML metadata and estimate a provisioning start time.
- @leah: send legal bundle to MacroHealth after you have SAMl confirmation.
- @taylor: add NovaGrid status to the pipeline spreadsheet (FYI: Q2 forecasting).

jess: Anything else? If not, I'll follow up in threads. :thumbsup:

leah: Nothing else from legal. Good luck!

sam-eng: Acked, will start once I have metadata.

jess: Closing the async standup — will post updates in-thread when infra starts. :)
